items.rationale: Clauses 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f) exclude claim-document translation even when the police report is required for cover. The conditional estimate is 2 hours × €90.
Clauses 7.1.8(e)–(f) exclude the translator's working materials and disbursements associated with the excluded translation. The conditional estimate is €15 for one charge.

items.description: Stolen watch, excluding the premium upgrade
items.rationale: Clause 7.1.9 values the watch at the pre-loss grade, and the unscheduled watch is capped at €2,500 under 4.2.2 and 4.4. Allocating the single €150 event deductible under 7.8 proportionally across the €3,000 covered loss gives €2,500 − €125 = €2,375.
The approximately €900 in stolen cash is capped at €500 under 2.3.3 and 4.2.3. Its proportional share of the single €150 event deductible is €25, leaving €475.
Clauses 2.3.4(a) and 7.1.10 exclude the sunglasses because they were mislaid separately, not taken in the robbery. The conditional estimate is €300 for one pair.
Clauses 5.2.3 and 7.1.8(b) exclude shipping for replacement property or documents, even when billed alongside a covered settlement. The conditional estimate is €26 for one shipment.
